subject: HelioEdge MAP: compliance runway and go/no-go for May close
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ward <tom.ward@helioedge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HelioEdge MAP: compliance runway and go/no-go for May close

Tom —

Thanks again for the demos last week. Per our conversation, attached is a first draft mutual action plan (MAP) that lays out the remaining milestones to close in May, with a special focus on the security checkpoints you highlighted (SOC 2 evidence, SIG/CAIQ responses, DPA sign-off, and data retention model). High level proposal:

- Target contract signature: week of May 9
- Security gate (SOC 2 + SIG answers): complete by April 22
- DPA redlines agreed and routed to DocuSign by April 28
- Data retention and export runbook delivered by May 3

Attachments: HelioEdge-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP with milestone owners/times), RI-SOC2-summary.pdf (what we can provide now), DPA-draft-HelioEdge.docx

Can you confirm whether the April 22 security gate is feasible on your side and whether your InfoSec team needs any additional artifacts (evidence packages, control narratives, or an onsite review)? If helpful I can loop in Karthik from our trust team for a brief sync.

Best,
Nikhil

--
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
nikhil@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Tom Ward <tom.ward@helioedge.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@helioedge.com>, security@helioedge.com
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelioEdge MAP: compliance runway and go/no-go for May close

Nikhil —

Thanks for the plan and the attachments. Quick notes from our side after an initial pass and a short security sync:

- April 22 security gate is tight but doable if we get full SIG/CAIQ answers by Apr 15 and the SOC 2 artifact bundle (encrypted) by Apr 18.
- For the SOC 2 bundle we need: latest Type II report (redacted ok), control mappings for encryption/key mgmt, and evidence of incident response drills in last 12 months.
- For SIG/CAIQ we prefer a completed CSV export of your responses plus any supporting docs linked in a shared folder.
- DPA: legal has two minor redlines (section 5 and 9) — if you can push an editable copy we will iterate and aim to return by Apr 20.
- Data retention: we need a clear SOW-style table with retention by data type, deletion timelines, and export/erasure runbook.

Can we schedule a 30-min trust sync on Apr 8 to confirm owners and delivery formats? My calendar has 11–11:30 PST free.

Tom
Tom Ward
Head of IT & Security, HelioEdge
+1 (206) 555-0789

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ward <tom.ward@helioedge.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: HelioEdge MAP: compliance runway and go/no-go for May close

Tom / Nikhil —

Following up from our internal review. I can own the SIG/CAIQ CSV and the SOC 2 evidence collection. Quick status and proposed delivery plan:

- SIG/CAIQ: I will export our latest responses and upload a CSV + reference docs to a secure share by Apr 14. Expect a short note mapping answers to HelioEdge's control IDs. Owner: Karthik Iyer (Trust).
- SOC 2 artifacts: We have a redacted Type II report (2026) and an evidence bundle. We will encrypt the bundle and share via secure link by Apr 18. Owner: Monica Patel (Compliance Manager).
- DPA: Lauren — I saw the redlines; I suggest we push a tracked DPA back to HelioEdge by Apr 12 so legal has time to iterate.
- Data retention runbook: Marissa will create the SOW-style retention table and an export/erasure checklist by May 3; I propose an interim doc by Apr 20 with the schema and deletion TTLs.

Go/no-go criteria we recommend for the Apr 22 security gate (must be all satisfied):
1) SIG/CAIQ CSV uploaded and mapped to controls
2) SOC 2 Type II available + encrypted evidence bundle delivered
3) DPA redlines acknowledged and a legal owner assigned for final sign-off
4) Data retention interim runbook with export/erasure checklist

If any of these are missing we classify the gate as "conditional" and propose specific remediation steps and dates (we can include a short SLA for evidence delivery). I can join the Apr 8 trust sync at 11:00 PST.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Trust & Security, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Ward <tom.ward@helioedge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelioEdge MAP: compliance runway and go/no-go for May close

Tom —

Thanks — appreciate the clarity. We are aligned on the gate checklist below; I updated the MAP to reflect owners and delivery dates and re-attached a version (HelioEdge-MAP-v1.xlsx). Summary and next steps: 

- Apr 8, 11:00 PST: Trust sync (calendar invite sent) — Karthik and Monica attending from Redwood
- Apr 12: Tracked DPA back to HelioEdge (Lauren)
- Apr 14: SIG/CAIQ CSV + mapping (Karthik)
- Apr 18: SOC 2 evidence bundle (Monica)
- Apr 20: HelioEdge returns DPA redlines (target)
- Apr 22: Security gate review — Go/No-Go decision
- May 3: Final data retention runbook (Marissa)
- May 9 (week of): Target signature / production onboarding

Go/No-Go criteria (as Karthik outlined): SIG CSV, SOC 2 bundle, DPA owner assigned, interim retention runbook. If everything is present on Apr 22 we will mark the gate as "GO" and commit to routing the contract to DocuSign that week. If any item is outstanding we will document the gap and propose a limited mitigation (e.g., interim SOC narrative + targeted compensating controls) and a new remediation date.

Tom — please confirm the Apr 8 time works and whether security@helioedge.com should receive the artifacts directly or via the secure share link we will send.

Best,
Nikhil
--
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
nikhil@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
